description.en: Feishu (Lark) OpenAPI MCP connection for DeepSeek Harness: bridges the official @larksuiteoapi/lark-mcp server, exposing IM, Bitable, Docs, Calendar and Drive APIs as mcp__feishu__* tools with OAuth user-token support.
